title: An ALMA/NOEMA study of gas dissipation and dust evolution in the 5 Myr-old HD 141569A hybrid disc
question: What are the physical parameters (dust and gas) of the gas-rich hybrid disc around HD 141569A, and what is its evolutionary status?

data.bands: ALMA Band 3 and Band 7; NOEMA 1.3 mm
data.arrays: NOEMA 7D/7C/6C configurations; ALMA 39 and 44 antennas (Band 3), 32 antennas (Band 7)

what.value: 12CO 1-0 integrated intensity 1.6 ± 0.2 Jy km/s (CARMA) used for opacity
Disc geometry PA=356°, i=53° from optical used to deproject visibilities

evidence.quote: we therefore first deprojected the visibilities assuming the geometric parameters derived at optical wavelength (PA= 356 [◦], _i_ = 53 [◦], Augereau et al. 1999)

recipe.goal: Continuum flux and size from uv-plane fits
recipe.method: Gaussian fits in uv plane: single elliptical, and two circular Gaussians after deprojection
Fit slope of flux vs frequency at three frequencies, β=α-2, with 10% calibration error added
12CO/13CO line ratio in 1 km/s channels, assuming 12C/13C=77
assumptions: Opacity ratio equals elemental abundance ratio 77

recipe.goal: Model CO disc structure in uv plane
recipe.method: Diskfit power-law models for Sigma, T, V, H fitted independently to each line in uv plane
assumptions: LTE, sharp outer edge, Gaussian vertical profile, constant local line width

recipe.method: CO mass from 13CO Sigma0, p, Rin, Rout with 12CO/13CO=77; H2 with ISM abundance; dust mass from mm flux and standard equation

evidence.quote: an inner cavity is confirmed with a radius R in = 17 ± 3 au from [12] CO J = 3→2
The [13] CO J = 2→1 data suggest a larger value R in = 35 ± 5 au.
R out = 275 ± 3 au by the two transitions of [12] CO
We obtain values for M dust in the range 0.03−0.52 M ⊕.
we can obtain a gas-to-dust mass ratio G / D in the range 135−2370.

not_stated_but_needed: MCMC settings (walkers, steps, priors, burn-in) for emcee
Line-free channels and continuum handling for line fits
Visibility binning and weighting in uv fits
Cell size, image size, clean masks and thresholds
missing_for_reproduction: Only a subset of Band 7 data was calibrated; which not stated
score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear model, but fitting and imaging details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is moderately complete and results are numeric.
